div.div:
What breaks without ordering
· configs before controllers → "no matches for kind IPAddressPool / PeerAuthentication" (CRD not installed)
· apps before labeled namespaces → pods start with 1/1 containers — no sidecar, no mTLS
· wait:false on controllers → dependants run while istiod webhook is still down
